items.title: Registration numbers recorded
items.requirement: The firm has recorded at least one official registration number (company number, LEI, or a tax or regulatory identifier).

items.title: On the official company registry
items.requirement: An official company registry (or GLEIF for an LEI) lists a company with this registration number and the firm's legal name.

items.title: Active
items.requirement: The registry shows the company as active: not struck off, dissolved, under liquidation or similar.

items.title: LEI consistent
items.requirement: If the firm gave an LEI, GLEIF's record for it names the same legal entity and is not lapsed or retired.
